Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that there were only two studio albums released between 2000 and 2009. In step 10, the WebSurfer explicitly listed three albums in the relevant timeframe: "2005 Corazón Libre", "2009 Cantora 1", and "2009 Cantora 2". Despite seeing "Cantora 2" clearly listed in the viewport text provided in step 10, the Planner ignored this third entry in step 11, erroneously stating there were only two albums and missing *Cantora 2*.
